text:
QUOTE: "**Schema, index older than server:** call `index(action='refresh', force=True)`." / "**Schema, index newer than server:** a rebuild re-stamps the same version and cannot clear `stale`. Restart the MCP client." / "**Code:** only a client restart helps."
VERDICT: MISS
WHY: The answer lists per-axis remedies (refresh for data, restart for code), but never explains that this difference is why a single flag would not have sufficed.
